None of the six claims stands as written. Set against the Lean and the one tested case: (1) is true by definition or false, depending on what "registers" means; (2) does not fit together and is false as a universal, and the exact condition has been in the package since 30 October; (3) puts what goes wrong in the closing where the proofs put it in taking beyond what comes back, and "narrowing to one" is neither needed nor enough; (4) is the record's own unread guess stated as known, and "no first" is the page's addition; (5) has one sentence the lake test contradicts and a "so" that does not follow; (6) is a universal drawn from a "can". This does not say the turn is wrong. It says the idea section says more than has been seen in six places, while the findings say less than the Lean holds: the modules on readings written between 26 October and 10 November are not mentioned and their content is listed under "Proved nowhere". I would hold the page and the AGENTS change until the five must-change findings are answered.

Is "What we do not know" honest about these? In part. Its third and fourth lines are honest, and they contradict the idea section, which says flatly "the account comes true of what they do" and "No value fixed once does that". Four more things are stated in the idea section as known and belong in the list: that there is no last loop; that what goes wrong is a closing and that narrowing to one is how it closes; that value, signal and line are one thing with one edge; that the map helps only where something a game rests on comes to count.

Is the guess a way of keeping "one map" unfalsifiable? As worded, yes. A question can be asked of anything, so "the same question holding" cannot fail. The record's guess was "one law holding at each level" (R11/LINKS-ON-PAPER.md line 178); a law can fail, and the draft changed it to a question. It arrives on the day four tries failed tests frozen beforehand, and it sets aside the sense of "one" those tests measured. Finding 8 gives a form that can fail.

The best objection to the whole turn, in three sentences. On the day four tries to join the map failed tests written down beforehand, the page answers with six paragraphs of new understanding, no proof, and a looser meaning of "one", agreed in conversation and not yet tried on a model, a case, or the modules on readings the Lean already has; that is the work choosing its next step from what it had just said, which the page itself names as how the direction is lost. The new centre, a "reading" made of value, signal and line, takes in whatever turns a loop and calls whatever does not "where the reading stops", so its main sentence cannot fail, while the cases that could test it (told of the bed and keeping it in 3 seasons of 10; a taker that needs nothing of what it uses up; a higher start that ends) are decided by what the turn moves away from: how much is taken against what comes back, and on whom the loss falls. And it moves what goes wrong from a condition anyone can check to a way of seeing that some have and others lack, which is the measure "who sees" that the page warns the map can become.
